decisions.notes: The packet's quote_mismatch=true is a false positive: the cited whiterivernow.com quote is present verbatim except that the packet rendered the embedded phrase with curly single quotation marks (U+2018/2019) where the source uses curly double quotation marks (U+201C/201D) -- a typographic transcription difference, not a misquote or fabrication. The primary ordinance text (No. 2026-21, reproduced on noticeregistry.com with OCR line-wrap artifacts like 'QUOR-UM' and 'DEL-CARE') independently confirms the emergency-clause five-year moratorium. Two additional independent trackers (Arkansas Advocate, savrn.com, aigridwatch.com) corroborate the Aug. 31, 2031 end date. A 5-year term is unusually long but is still a defined, expiring pause, not a permanent ban -- criterion (a) is satisfied.
